{{Top|leg}}
'''Politorate officers''', known as '''Pols''', were members of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]'s [[Politorate]] branch. They were assigned to each [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] and garrison within the Alignment and ensured that all actions undertaken by Alignment personnel were in accordance with the ideals of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Politorate officers could call for investigations in the loyalty of an personnel and had authority to remove individuals from command positions if deemed necessary.
